chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem.
Psalm 121
chapter.v:
I look
up to the mountains—does my help come from there?

My help
comes from the Lord,who made heaven and earth!

He will
not let you stumble;the one who watches over you will not slumber.

Indeed, he
who watches over Israelnever slumbers or sleeps.

The Lord
himself watches over you! The Lord stands beside you as your protective shade.

The sun
will not harm you by day,nor the moon at night.

The Lord
keeps you from all harmand watches over your life.

The Lord
keeps watch over you as you come and go,both now and forever.
